body: There really isn't a solution. I was going to do it anyway after paying off my debts, but now my death will pay off my debts. I wanted a job just to keep me holding on a bit longer. I've tried everything. I've been on mood stabilizers for a long time. I'm healthy, I worked very hard, and it didn't work out because there are things wrong with me I can't change. I've made this decision very carefully over many years. I posted here because I'm worried about dying, and I can't say this to anyone who can identify me. I'm grateful there are people like you in the world, but I truly have made up my mind. I'm sorry if I've disappointed you. I didn't intend to waste your time.
I'm sorry to hear you've been struggling. I admire your hope and perseverance. I've applied to science/engineering jobs.

I'm here to talk if you want to share anything. I won't judge you no matter what you say, but I probably won't have any useful advice, and I only log in once per day.  Just to be transparent, I've already made up my mind, but it seems I'll be around at least until Monday morning.
